image_alt: A man in a blue top stands with a pale whippet at a crossing of paths in tall conifer woodland.

text.facebook: The UK's animal poison centre is getting about a call a day about pets eating drugs, a record, with many found on walks, even in the woods. Most calls are about nicotine and cannabis. If you think your dog has eaten drugs, the poisons service says go straight to your vet. My tip: keep your dog close in car parks and picnic spots, where most rubbish is. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/drugs-found-on-walks
